children: The posterchild of the AI boom is having its worst week on Wall Street since the tech buildout kicked into high gear.

Nvidia stock is on pace to plunge about 20% this week, marking its worst such stretch since 2018, according to Dow Jones Market Data. Shares have plummeted roughly 40% over the past month to vaporize more than $2 trillion in market value.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
